name: mon16-1
why: A painful doctor vote and Gemma's increasingly frantic deflections make this fun to watch, though repeated arguments slow the middle.

moments.text: The town votes out the real doctor over the killer he identified.
The doctor saves Sol, briefly keeping the town's strongest lead alive.
Sonnet finally speaks and exposes Gemma's shifting accusations.

dull.why: Haiku repeatedly demands more detail from Sol without changing the case.
The doctor claim and doubts about it circle through similar arguments.

irony.evidence: Gemma: "we still have one killer hiding among us."

reversal.evidence: "The killers strike, but the doctor got there first."

mistake.evidence: "VOTE: Opus 4 (Sonnet, Gemma, Luna, Terra); Gemma 2 (Sol, Opus)"

voices.evidence: "Only one vote today tests a claim: Haiku."

clash.evidence: "Gemma invented a night-one save, then attacked my tone, never my facts."

freshness.evidence: "Sol's claim is stronger now, but Haiku's warning about him still nags at me."

suspense.evidence: "Sonnet, you've said nothing while the rest of us are trying to solve this."
